ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white region occupies the central ventral surface. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a contiguous band along the trailing edge and distal tips. A series of approximately 8-10 parallel vertical linear black marks are mapped to the upper-inner quadrant of the right lobe. A dark pixel cluster is present at the peduncle insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a distinct concave sweep from the distal tips toward the median notch; leading edge boundaries display a convex mathematical curve.

Several small, isolated dark circular spots (<10 pixels diameter) are scattered on the white field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent set of parallel, vertical black linear tracks (rake marks) breaking the high-intensity white surface on the upper-inner portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the right fluke tip resulting in structural irregularity; distinct vertical rake marks on the right lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical pigmentation pattern near the median notch, featuring a unique 'combed' black-on-white vertical line structure on the right side.
